title: Quickstart mosaic: annotated model cards + pricing snapshots for release notes
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Create a compact, publication-ready set of onboarding visuals for the upcoming model-catalog release notes and quickstart docs. Deliver a mosaic of annotated model 'cards' that show: model name and short descriptor, latency & cost badges, availability tags (Hosted / Dedicated / Private), deprecation banner state when applicable, and an expanded pricing snapshot modal. Assets should support desktop and narrow/mobile layouts and include dark-mode variants for embedding in docs and the product release announcement.

Primary goals:
- Make it extremely clear which models are new vs deprecated in the release notes UI blocks.
- Surface pricing delta between runtime variants (quantized vs full-precision) with simple per-1k-token callouts.
- Provide one hero screenshot for the quickstart that pairs a highlighted model card with a short code snippet area and a CTA.

Key constraints/notes:
- Must match Console typography tokens and color tokens (refer to Figma style library: Figma -> /Redwood/Console/DesignTokens).
- Use production screenshots where possible; otherwise use high-fidelity mockups that can be swapped by Eng during the final runbook.
- Provide transparent PNGs and SVG exports for marketing/docs. 
- Annotated source file (Figma) should include layers and redlines for Engineering handoff (margins, exact copy, alt text).

Deliverables (summary): annotated Figma file, 3 hero screenshots (desktop/dark/ mobile), 6 model-card variations (new, default, deprecated, price-tier, regional pricing, protected/private flag), pricing snapshot modal (desktop + mobile), handoff checklist, export pack (SVG/PNG/WEBP) and a short README for docs integration.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with named layers and redline notes is uploaded to Project > Design Files and linked in comments

Six distinct model-card mocks covering all states exported as SVG and 2x PNG
Pricing snapshot modal includes clear per-1k token pricing and toggle between quantized/full-precision costs
Docs team confirms assets integrate into release notes without layout regressions
Design sign-off from PM and a quick visual QA pass by Engineering
